deadline.value: Students are advised to apply early; it is possible to start postgraduate research at any point in the year subject to school confirmation.
deadline.quote: Although we advise students to start in September/October, it's often possible to start postgraduate research at any point in the year. You can state your preferred start date in your application, although this will need to be confirmed by the academic school.

entry_route.value: Entry requirements vary depending on what you study; some subjects require a master's degree, while others ask for a good undergraduate degree (2:1 or First).
entry_route.quote: Information about academic entry requirements is available from the school in which your research is based. Entry requirements vary depending on what you study – some subjects require a masters degree, others ask for a good undergraduate degree (a 2:1 or a First). Links to school webpages are provided on the Find A PhD page.

supervisor.value: Applicants wishing to research their own idea must contact the relevant academic school before formal application to check supervisor availability.
supervisor.quote: If you want to research your own idea, you should contact the relevant academic school before you submit a formal application, to check that they have an appropriately-qualified supervisor in the area you'd like to study.

funding.value: PhD opportunities and Centres for Doctoral Training offer competitive funding and research studentships.
funding.quote:
